ALGE-Timing is an Austrian manufacturer of sports timing equipment and display boards, based in
Lustenau. It began in 1946 as a radio business, has made timing devices since the early 1970s and
has been part of the Italian company [Microgate](microgate.md) since 2023.[^company][^swz] Its
swimming products include the [TM-SWIM](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-tm-swim.md) timing console
and the [Timy](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-timy.md) timer.

## History

Josef Alge set up a radio workshop under his own name in 1946. He repaired radios, and later devised
a thread monitor for embroidery machines that brought the firm its first exports.[^lustenau] ALGE's
list of its past products also has electric fences, master clocks and siren controls.[^hist2001de]

The Lustenau municipality credits the move into timing to his son Günther Alge, who built an electric
timing computer with photocells for a ski club in the early 1970s.[^lustenau] Günther Alge and Gerda
Vetter, the second generation, took over in 1977 according to ALGE's 2001 history page and in 1976
according to its 2018 one.[^hist2001][^about2018] The
[TdC 2000](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-tdc-2000.md), which ALGE describes as its breakthrough
and its first data-processing timer, is under 1978 in the company's timeline. The manual for the
later [TdC 4000](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-tdc-4000.md) gives October
1979.[^company][^about2018][^tdc4000]

The cousins Albert Vetter and Wolfgang Alge became equal partners in
1998.[^hist2001de][^about2018] ALGE dates its change of name to ALGE-Timing to that year. In the
register timeline the limited company was called Elektronik Entwicklungs-GmbH until
1999.[^about2018][^northdata] Alge-Timing GmbH & Co contributed its business to the limited company
under an agreement of November 2008.[^northdata] The commercial register entry, FN 64761m, is dated 1
December 1993, which is the date of registration and not of founding.[^register]

Microgate, of Bolzano, took control in autumn 2023. Press reports of 6 October 2023 gave ALGE about
20 employees and 2022 sales of 4.5 million euros, against about 60 employees and 14 million euros at
Microgate.[^swz][^salto] The owners had no successor within their families, and an interview
published by their advisers calls Microgate the new majority owner.[^loos] Margot Biasi and Federico
Gori joined them as managing directors, and the two brands stayed separate.[^salto][^company] The
International Military Sports Council (CISM) describes the deal as an investment for
shares.[^cism]

Wolfgang Alge's departure as managing director was published in March 2025 and Albert Vetter's in
June 2026, when Wolfgang Sparer was appointed.[^northdata][^register] An entry of 11 July 2026 has
Microgate S.r.l. as the only shareholder, with a contribution equal to the whole share
capital.[^register] ALGE's company page, as of November 2026, still names Vetter and Alge as running
the firm.[^company]

ALGE reported 25 employees in 2001, 19 in 2018 and 18 in 2026. It sells through independent
representatives in more than 40 countries.[^hist2001][^about2018][^company]

## Products

ALGE makes timing devices, start equipment, photocells, radio links and display boards for sports
that include alpine skiing, show jumping, athletics and swimming.[^cat2017] This wiki covers the
following swimming equipment.

- Timing: the [TM-SWIM](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-tm-swim.md) console, the
  [Timy](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-timy.md) timer, the earlier
  [SWIM 2000](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-swim-2000.md) and
  [Timer S4](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-timer-s4.md), and the
  [WTN](../equipment/swimming/accessories/alge-wtn.md) radio network.
- Starts: the [SU3](../equipment/swimming/starter/alge-su3.md) start unit, the
  [BANG](../equipment/swimming/external-speaker/alge-bang.md) speakers, the
  [E-START](../equipment/swimming/starter/alge-e-start.md) and the
  [STB1](../equipment/swimming/starter/alge-stb1.md) horn.
- Lane equipment: the [TP touchpads](../equipment/swimming/touchpad/alge-tp-touchpads.md),
  [SWT3](../equipment/swimming/deck-cabling/alge-swt3.md) lane terminals,
  [SPA2 and SPP2](../equipment/swimming/external-speaker/alge-spa2-spp2.md) lane speakers and the
  [023-02](../equipment/swimming/semi-automatic/pushbutton/alge-023-02.md) push button.
- Blocks: the [SO5](../equipment/swimming/starting-blocks/alge-so5.md) and the
  [SO4 and So7](../equipment/swimming/starting-blocks/alge-so4.md) starting platforms, the
  [SWR7](../equipment/swimming/relay-judging/alge-swr7.md) relay sensor and the
  [BSA](../equipment/swimming/backstroke-start/alge-bsa.md) backstroke ledge.
- Displays: the [D-SW](../equipment/common/scoreboard/alge-d-sw.md) swimming boards and the
  [D-LINE](../equipment/common/scoreboard/alge-d-line.md),
  [D-RTNM](../equipment/common/scoreboard/alge-d-rtnm.md) and
  [GAZ5](../equipment/common/scoreboard/alge-gaz5.md) boards.
- Software: [SwimTime](../software/meet-management/swimtime.md), which operates the TM-SWIM, and
  [DisplayStudio](../software/display/alge-displaystudio.md).

ALGE holds a German patent on a swimming touch device, filed in November 2014 and granted in December
2023, with Wolfgang Alge as inventor. A sensor sits between a front unit and a plate fixed to the pool
edge, and openings in both let water drain through the device.[^patent] The [TP touchpads](../equipment/swimming/touchpad/alge-tp-touchpads.md) article
covers it.

## In swim timing

The Timer S4 system, described in a 1997 installation guide, ran eight lanes from a multi-sport
timer.[^s4] The SWIM 2000, on ALGE's site by January 2001, used a PC and a controller with chained
lane terminals for up to 12 lanes.[^web2001][^swim2000] By October 2007 ALGE was offering the TM-SWIM
TimeManager as its fully automatic system and a package built on the Timy for semi-automatic
timing.[^swim2007] See the
[semi-automatic timing overview](../equipment/swimming/semi-automatic/index.md) for that class of
equipment.

[Hy-Tek Meet Manager](../software/meet-management/hy-tek-meet-manager.md) reads the SWIM 2000 over a serial cable
and the Timy through a shared results file.[^hytek][^hytektimy]
[Splash Meet Manager](../software/meet-management/splash-meet-manager.md) has interfaces for the S4, the SWIM 2000 and
SwimTime.[^splash]

The TM-SWIM sounds the start tone over its lane speakers, at a frequency and length set in
SwimTime.[^manual] The [start-systems overview](../equipment/swimming/starter/index.md#start-tones)
compares this tone with the CTS, Swiss Timing and Daktronics tones.

<figure class="wiki-figure">
  <audio controls preload="metadata" src="/assets/start-tone-alge.mp3" aria-label="ALGE start tone"><a href="/assets/start-tone-alge.mp3">ALGE start tone (MP3)</a></audio>
  <figcaption>An ALGE start tone, rebuilt from recordings of an ALGE system: a pure tone at the 1800 Hz, 0.2-second defaults.</figcaption>
</figure>

In North America the equipment is sold by [ALGE-Swim USA](alge-swim-usa.md), often together with
scoreboards from [JS PROdisplays](js-prodisplays.md), and by [Nevco](nevco.md), which announced a
swimming partnership with ALGE in June 2024.[^usarefs][^nevcopr] The Australian distributor is
[Split Second Timing](split-second-timing.md).[^sstau]

## In competition

Result sheets from the swimming at the 2014 European championships in Berlin credit the timing to
ALGE and the data processing to [Microplus](microplus.md).[^berlin] Albert Vetter named that event
and the 2011 alpine world ski championships as examples of the firm's international work. In the same
article the owners said they neither wished nor were able to compete for the Olympic Games, where
larger groups are sponsors as well as timekeepers.[^lustenau]

ALGE supplied timing equipment, starting blocks and scoreboards for the swimming at the 2024 CISM
Cadet Games in Venezuela, and CISM then extended the partnership through 2028.[^cism] The results of
the 53rd CISM World Military Swimming Championship, held at Warendorf, Germany, in December 2024,
record automatic timing by an ALGE system in an eight-lane, 50 m pool.[^warendorf]

Split Second Timing names SWIM 2000 installations at the Warringah Aquatic Centre, Dubbo RSL Club and
Belconnen Aquatic Centre in Australia.[^sstau] ALGE-Swim USA's 2026 reference brochure lists these
North American ones.[^usapdf]

| Facility | Location | Year |
|---|---|---|
| Providence Aquatic Center | Jacksonville, Florida | 2025 |
| City of Harrison Aquatic Center | Harrison, Arkansas | 2025 |
| North Shore Aquatic Complex | St. Petersburg, Florida | 2026 |
| The Salvation Army Kroc Center | Salem, Oregon | 2026 |
| Southwest High School | Minneapolis, Minnesota | 2026 |
| Loyalist Barr Homes Aquatic Centre | Kingston, Ontario | 2026 |
| Transit Middle School | Williamsville, New York | 2026 |
| Elkhorn High School | Elkhorn, Nebraska | 2026 |

The brochure says four of these replaced another maker's equipment, while the company's web page says
that five of six did.[^usapdf][^usarefs]
